Justice Kagan Criticizes Supreme Court's Impact on Democracy

Justice Elena Kagan has stated that recent rulings by the Supreme Court have damaged democracy. She warned that these decisions are fueling polarization and undermining the democratic process. Kagan's remarks indicate a concern about the Court's influence on the political landscape.
